item.title: A Fresh Start
item.description: This post marks a frest start of this new blog. There existed two blogs before this, overall containing around 25-30 unique posts. I’m deleting all those now, and this blog will be start of a higher-quality, and better blog. All those posts were written by me when I was kind of learning and experimenting with blogging at the same time.
